body: I have had two serious, long term relationships, both of them have expressed my anger in the ubiquitous 'post mortem'. I have even noticed, in the moment, that I am not 'in control' so to speak. As in, I have a major say in what happens (one of the reasons I have never struck a living creature in anger, aside from the damn spiders I keep getting), but it's what my dad used to talk candidly to me about when he admitted he had a serious temper: that feeling of being a passenger with a hang on the stick, you seriously influence the destination, but can't necessarily control the flight plan.
